envelope.text: must be a stateless callable that decays to `TypedGoalFn`

why:
installs the accept/reject decision for an incoming goal, returning `nros::GoalResponse`. rclcpp_action takes the same callback as the `handle_goal` argument of `create_server`; ours is a setter because RFC-0041 binds callbacks to the entity AFTER creation, which is what lets a component construct the entity in static storage and wire it up in its own `on_init`. Takes a STATELESS callable (empty-capture lambda or function pointer): there is no `std::function` here, so per-instance closure storage does not exist -- `set_goal_callback_with_ctx` is the spelling that carries state.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
